verdict.rationale: Google Cloud provides official CLI install quickstarts (gcloud install, curl-based install) and API/client library docs, which support getting started, but there's no evidence pack item showing a single end-to-end quickstart with exact commands taking a developer from zero to a running deployed service in under an hour. Evidence is limited to CLI setup and API reference pages rather than a concrete 'deploy a service' walkthrough. missing for 10: a documented end-to-end quickstart tutorial with exact deploy commands, timing/benchmark claims, and independent corroboration that it works within an hour.
